note: Shares are FFXIV posts over classifiable posts in the sampled feed. A post is FFXIV when its text, tags, alt text, link card or quoted post contains a focus term (termHits). Unclassified = fewer than 3 letters of text (image-only or emoji-only); they are left out of the share. nonFfxivWithImages counts non-FFXIV posts that carry images, which may still be FFXIV screenshots. The sample covers the newest items only, so an old account's history beyond it is not measured.
